admission.justification: Spans mcp/registration/knowledge.py and models/tools/tool_answer.py, is guarded by description, schema-budget, and records-view tests, and preserves bounded MCP surface cost while enabling verbatim 20-record batch pages.

applicability: MCP registration and tool-answer token-bound enforcement for knowledge_read.
conditions: Exposes only minimal read-only selector parameters (repo_id, contractPath, files, folder, query, kinds, recordIds, compact) with no write or format flags, keeps raw tool description <= 500 characters, and stays within role schema byte budgets.
Raises only TOOL_ANSWER_EXCEPTIONS[('knowledge_read', None)] to 5,000 tokens via exception_ceiling_for while keeping every other tool exception capped at 4,000 tokens.
exclusions: Does not add a second mounted knowledge-read tool or raise the 4,000-token ceiling for any other MCP tool.
statement: knowledge_read remains one read-only MCP tool with minimal selector parameters within CAP-L4 role byte budgets and the 500-character raw description ceiling, with its tool-answer exception raised to 5,000 tokens.
title: knowledge_read keeps minimal selectors, 500-char description, 5000 bound
